newsitem.title: USA: Unisys unit gets $45 mln in contracts.
newsitem.headline: Unisys unit gets $45 mln in contracts.

text.p: Unisys Corp said Monday its federal systems division had received two subcontracts from the Defense Department's information systems agency, carrying a total value of about $45 million.
The company will be responsible for installation and testing, general maintenance and technical support as part of a subcontract at the agency's global command and control system.
The project is a subcontract from Raytheon Co's E-Systems. The total value of the contract is $193 million, of which Unisys will receive about $25 million.

The company also is a subcontractor to Validity Corp of Encinitas, Calif., to support the missions and functions of the Army's Joint Interoperability Test Command in Fort Huachuca, Ariz. The five-year task-order contract is worth $130 million, of which Unisys would receive more than $20 million, the company said.

The company will be responsible for migration systems, software development, electronic commerce/electronic data interchange standards, open systems standards and portable operating system interfaces.
